package.description: A lightweight desktop utility that forwards selected text.

en-US.description: A lightweight desktop utility that forwards selected text.
en-US.longDescription: SelectBridge is a lightweight desktop utility that forwards text selected in supported desktop applications to a configurable URL target. It runs as a native tray application on Windows, supports immediate, modifier-key, custom-shortcut, icon, and dot trigger modes, and can open a GoldenDict-ng popup or any custom URL template.
en-US.name: SelectBridge

zh-CN.description: 一个轻量的桌面工具，可将选中的文字转发到可配置的 URL 目标。
zh-CN.longDescription: SelectBridge 是一个轻量的桌面工具，可将受支持的桌面应用中选中的文字转发到可配置的 URL 目标。Windows 上以原生系统托盘应用运行，支持立即、修饰键、自定义快捷键、图标和圆点触发方式，可通过 goldendict:// 打开 GoldenDict-ng 查询弹窗或任意自定义 URL 模板。
